ai.seo_question: What does the Quranic phrase 'Khafidatan Rafi'ah' mean regarding God's attributes?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase encapsulates the dynamic nature of divine justice (Adl), where God actively lowers the proud and raises the humble, reflecting both His absolute power and His mercy. It serves as a reminder that true elevation is spiritual humility, a core tenet in the teachings of the Ahl al-Bayt regarding the purification of the self (Tazkiyah).
